steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Genre hybridity is the combination of conventions from two or more distinct genres within a single film, creating a new blended category. | Key Fact: Sub-genres are more specific categories within a broader genre, such as slasher horror within horror or space opera within science fiction. | Key Fact: Genre mixing has become increasingly common in contemporary cinema as studios seek to attract wider and more diverse audiences. | Key Fact: Postmodern genre theory argues that in a media-saturated culture, pure genres no longer exist — all contemporary films are to some extent hybrid.
